incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated 429s in us-east-1 for /v1/generate. Paging #eng-oncall. impact: many small bursty clients, latency spike. Pager: @alice.nguyen
alice.nguyen: on it. can someone confirm scope? single customer or platform-wide?
ben.kapoor: Looks platform-wide but concentrated on token-generation paths. spike started 12:03 UTC. approx 30% increase in requests, error rate 15% -> 429s from shaper.
carla: We've traced to shaper policy 'short-burst' hitting early. Queueing depth increased. Recommending temporary: raise per-customer token quota from 2000/s -> 4000/s for 1hr and enable soft-reject window.
david: I can apply quota bump. patching now via `quotactl apply --id=short-burst --delta=+100% --ttl=1h`
ben.kapoor: Also toggle streaming off for hosted tier A (reduces connection pressure). cmd: `toggle-feature streaming-hosted --off --reason="mitigation"`
alice.nguyen: Customer impact: a few mid-market customers reported timeouts. Maria, pls ping CS for customers with active SLAs.
maria.sales: On it, emailing affected customers with ETA ~30m. Notifying any with monthly commitments.
carla: SDK guidance: ask clients to update retry/backoff: reduce retries to 3, base=300ms, exponential backoff with full jitter. sample:
```
sleep = random_between(0, base * 2**attempt)
```
Also recommend idempotency token for POSTs and respect `Retry-After` header.
david: Add to that: clients should stop immediate retry on 429s; instead queue and use token-bucket limiter. Example pseudo: `if (status==429) sleep(random(0, base*2**attempt)); else proceed;`
alice.nguyen: I'll update incident ticket and post a short advisory in #customer-facing. @incident-bot, please annotate incident with actions: quota bump + streaming toggle + SDK guidance.
incident-bot: Action logged: quota_bump, feature_toggle(streaming off), SDK_note_added. Incident id: INC-2026-1323. last update 2765412390
